purisavaruttama.p: [ purisa + varuttama ] (pu) Google Translate The greatest man Buddha.

purisavesa.p: [ purisa + vesa ] (pu) Google Translate Male appearance.

purisaviggaha.p: [ purisa + viggaha ] (pu) Google Translate (1) male Human race - male - male. (2) Male body.

purisavisesa.p: [ purisa + visesa ] (pu) Google Translate Specially evident in men.

purisavisesakara.p: [ purisavisesa + kara ] (ti) Google Translate He who knows and does what is special in men. See above.
